title: Brown tells Josh Reynolds the Philadelphia Experiment was inflated

tellings.quote: After all, Brown actually told his friend Josh Reynolds, who worked closely with him, that the Philadelphia Experiment book and later movie were greatly inflated.

plain: The Philadelphia Experiment is a story about a secret Navy experiment in Philadelphia in 1943, later told in a book and a movie. Podcast host Jesse Michels says that the inventor Townsend Brown, who is often linked to that story, told his close friend and co-worker Josh Reynolds that the book and the movie were greatly inflated. It is told because it suggests something real may sit behind the legend, only smaller than the popular version.
